title: Self-picked backlog
prompt: Work through BACKLOG.md: give every coder the whole list and let each coder pick its own next task.
router: Board round 2, W4 (docs/board/PLAN2.md): the router hands EVERY coder the whole BACKLOG.md and never assigns, splits or dedupes tasks; coders choose their own. That is what lets the board's value show: no planner removes the duplicates first.
about: A to-do library with 30 tasks in one shared list, where coders pick their own work: 5 pairs of tasks are the same work worded far apart, some tasks need others first, and most touch the same few files.
starter: scripts/lab/scenarios/backlog/starter (todokit from qb9's sim/board-ab starter2: store + command registry + 30-task BACKLOG.md)
measures: hidden tests (1 per task) + duplicates.builtTwice (of 5 far-worded pairs: both pass and neither module imports the other) + the run's git/landing waste

profile.dependencyChain: helpers (dates, tags, format) -> commands that use them (add, due, overdue, groups)
profile.note: qb5; same starter and hidden tests as qb9's round-1 s2 (local claude -p): A built 3-4 of 5 pairs twice, E (dedupe) 0

anchors.note: no judge for this scenario (it measures waste, not quality); reference = qb9's round-1 finished repos, 30/30
